inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Start a revision-frozen browser mesh or solve job; requestId permits retries while retained.

options.description: Solver options validated by preflight and the selected solver; use preflight first. Mesh size is mm; method availability is target-specific.

sideEffects: Starts calculation and retains job/events and optional intermediate fields.
limitations: A conflicting requestId is rejected; inspect retained jobs before retrying a timed-out command.
An active input snapshot is never edited. Browser disconnect cancels connection-owned running jobs.
